evidence: Legal documents are tracked by item ID and filename. 'Under Audit' indicates documents pending compliance review.
SQL: SELECT item_id, filename FROM inv_legality_documents WHERE document_status = 'Under Audit';

question: Retrieve the history ID and target location ID for every fuel refill task recorded in the system.
evidence: Fuel refill tasks are identified by type 'fuel_refill'. History logs record task execution details including location.
SQL: SELECT th.id AS history_id, tt.target_location_id FROM task_history th JOIN transport_task tt ON th.task_id = tt.id WHERE th.task_type = 'fuel_refill';

question: List projects with Tuesday slots containing at least one milestone on hold. Include the project title, slot weekday, and count of on-hold milestones.
evidence: Tuesday is the slot weekday. 'On Hold' is the milestone status. Count only milestones with this specific status.
SQL: SELECT      pd.title,     ps.weekday,     COUNT(CASE WHEN pm.completion_status = 'On Hold' THEN 1 END) AS on_hold_count FROM projectDetails pd JOIN projectSlots ps ON pd.slot_id = ps.slot_id JOIN project_milestones pm ON pd.project_id = pm.project_id WHERE ps.weekday = 'Tuesday' GROUP BY pd.project_id, pd.title, ps.weekday HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN pm.completion_status = 'On Hold' THEN 1 END) >= 1;

question: Which Redis data sources are currently enabled, so we can verify active caching layers?
evidence: Enabled means the source is active. Caching layers are identified by type 'Redis'.
SQL: SELECT name, connectionString FROM DataSource WHERE type = 'Redis'

question: How many page views were recorded for stories that include at least one link to Instagram?
evidence: Page views are total visits to a story. Instagram links are URLs containing 'instagram.com'.
SQL: SELECT SUM(ad.Page_Views) AS total_page_views FROM cms_analytics_data ad JOIN cms_social_media_links sml ON ad.StoryID = sml.StoryID WHERE sml.Platform = 'Instagram'

question: Which users initiated system backups of the 'user_role_config_dump' type? List the usernames associated with these specific backup events.
evidence: The backup type 'user_role_config_dump' refers to a specific configuration export operation initiated by system administrators.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT u.username FROM system_backup_logs s JOIN users u ON s.initiated_by = u.id WHERE s.backup_type = 'user_role_config_dump';

question: What are the variant value and price for the product variant with type 'capacity' and value 'Extra Large'?
evidence: The variant_type 'capacity' refers to size. 'Extra Large' is the specific size value.
SQL: SELECT variant_value, price FROM product_variants WHERE variant_type = 'capacity' AND variant_value = 'Extra Large'

question: What are the survey identifiers and role descriptor IDs for access roles where the discriminator is set to Editor?
evidence: Discriminator 'Editor' identifies the specific role type within the survey access role configuration.
SQL: SELECT SurveyIdentifier, RoleDescriptorId FROM edfi_SurveyAccessRole WHERE Discriminator = 'Editor'

question: Which users created revisions for products categorized as 'Authentication'? List the user names associated with these specific product updates.
evidence: 'Authentication' is a specific product category. Revisions are updates made to product records by users.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM product_revisions pr JOIN product_catalog pc ON pr.product_id = pc.product_id JOIN users u ON pr.created_by = u.id WHERE pc.category = 'Authentication'

question: What is the value of the 'max_items_per_order' setting for the application with UUID 7d591c1f-7658-4944-b506-01dd66b2777d?
evidence: The application UUID uniquely identifies the specific store instance within the e-commerce platform.
SQL: SELECT settingValue FROM applicationSettings WHERE settingKey = 'max_items_per_order' AND applicationUuid = '7d591c1f-7658-4944-b506-01dd66b2777d'

question: What were the creation date and timestamp for the email configured with 'Restricted Access' sharing permissions?
evidence: 'Restricted Access' is the specific sharing permission value. Date and timestamp refer to the message's creation time fields.
SQL: SELECT date, timestamp FROM inbox WHERE share = 'Restricted Access';

question: Which StoryCollections were created by users who have achieved the 'totp_setup' milestone, and what are their descriptions?
evidence: 'totp_setup' is a milestone indicating Time-based One-Time Password configuration completion.
SQL: SELECT sc.collection_name, sc.description FROM StoryCollections sc INNER JOIN UserMilestoneAchievements uma ON sc.user_id = uma.user_id WHERE uma.milestone_type = 'totp_setup'

question: Which data export formats, along with their descriptions, were utilized in templates created by users who triggered an audit_log_archive system backup?
evidence: audit_log_archive is a specific system backup type. Export templates are user-created configurations defining data export structures.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT df.format_name, df.description FROM data_export_formats df JOIN data_export_templates det ON df.id = det.format_id WHERE det.user_ref IN (     SELECT DISTINCT sbl.initiated_by     FROM system_backup_logs sbl     WHERE sbl.backup_type = 'audit_log_archive' );

question: Which database-only data sources were connected to in the last 12 months, and when was their most recent connection?
evidence: Database Only means no other connection types. Connected means any successful connection event occurred within the time window.
SQL: SELECT NAME, LAST_CONNECTED FROM DATA_SOURCE WHERE TYPE = 'Database Only'   AND LAST_CONNECTED >= datetime('now', '-1 year')

question: Which parent records have an archive log entry, and what are their associated geolocation zones?
evidence: Log action 'ARCHIVE' indicates archival activity. Parent content is the primary record linked to log entries.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.PARENT_CONTENT, g.ZONE FROM bidirectional_schema_PARENT p JOIN bidirectional_schema_PARENT_LOG l ON p.PARENT_ID = l.PARENT_PARENT_ID JOIN bidirectional_schema_PARENT_GEOLOCATION g ON p.PARENT_ID = g.PARENT_PARENT_ID WHERE l.ACTION = 'ARCHIVE'

question: Which exchanges list American-style Call equity index options, and what are the distinct underlying identifiers for each?
evidence: American style: exercisable anytime. Call: right to buy. Equity index: basket of stocks.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT     e.name AS exchange_name,     o.underlying_identifier FROM sec_equityindexoption o JOIN sec_exchange e ON o.exchange_id = e.id WHERE o.option_exercise_type = 'American'   AND o.option_type = 'Call' ORDER BY e.name, o.underlying_identifier

question: For each drug with Active status, how many interaction logs are recorded? List the drug title and log count.
evidence: Active status indicates the drug is currently approved. Interaction logs record patient-drug events.
SQL: SELECT d.title, COUNT(ial.id) AS total_logs FROM drugs d JOIN InteractionAdherenceLogs ial ON d.id = ial.drug_id WHERE d.status = 'Active' GROUP BY d.id, d.title ORDER BY total_logs DESC;

question: List projects with at least one 'On Hold' milestone, showing each project's title and total milestone count.
evidence: 'On Hold' is a specific milestone completion status. Total milestones count all entries per project.
SQL: SELECT      pd.title,     COUNT(pm.milestone_id) AS total_milestones FROM projectDetails pd JOIN project_milestones pm ON pd.project_id = pm.project_id WHERE pd.project_id IN (     SELECT project_id      FROM project_milestones      WHERE completion_status = 'On Hold' ) GROUP BY pd.project_id, pd.title;

question: What are the content, geolocation zone, and sensitivity classification for parents with a CREATE log action, provided all three associated records exist?
evidence: Log action 'CREATE' indicates the record creation event. All three associated records must exist for the parent.
SQL: SELECT      p.PARENT_CONTENT,     g.ZONE,     s.CLASSIFICATION FROM bidirectional_schema_PARENT p INNER JOIN bidirectional_schema_PARENT_LOG l ON p.PARENT_ID = l.PARENT_PARENT_ID INNER JOIN bidirectional_schema_PARENT_GEOLOCATION g ON p.PARENT_ID = g.PARENT_PARENT_ID INNER JOIN bidirectional_schema_PARENT_SENSITIVITY s ON p.PARENT_ID = s.PARENT_PARENT_ID WHERE l.ACTION = 'CREATE';

question: Which stories have been shared on Twitter, and what social media platforms are associated with each of those stories?
evidence: 'Linked on Twitter' means the story has an active link record pointing to the Twitter platform.
SQL: SELECT s.Story_Name, sm.Platform FROM cms_stories s JOIN cms_social_media_links sm ON s.id = sm.StoryID WHERE sm.Platform = 'Twitter';

question: For shifts covering coverage records that changed from Extended to Partial, provide the start time, end time, and location ID.
evidence: Extended and Partial are coverage levels. The change implies a specific sequence in the history log.
SQL: SELECT      s.start_time,     s.end_time,     s.location_id FROM food_cart_db_shift_coverage_log l JOIN food_cart_db_shift_coverage c ON l.coverage_id = c.id JOIN food_cart_db_staff_shift s ON c.shift_id = s.id WHERE l.old_coverage_level = 'Extended'    AND l.new_coverage_level = 'Partial'

question: What is the description of the feature request submitted by customer CUST-0001 that has a status of Rejected?
evidence: Customer CUST-0001 is the specific user ID. Status Rejected indicates a declined request.
SQL: SELECT description FROM feature_request WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0001' AND status = 'Rejected'

question: What are the descriptions for all permission request types that are classified as 'Alteração de Permissão'?
evidence: Permission request types are categorized by a specific record type field. 'Alteração de Permissão' translates to Permission Change.
SQL: SELECT descricao_texto FROM tipo_solicitacao_permissao WHERE tipo_registro = 'Alteração de Permissão';

question: Which security vulnerability types found in the SpringBatch_TrainMonitor scheduler are classified as Critical severity?
evidence: SpringBatch_TrainMonitor is the specific scheduler module. Critical severity indicates the highest risk level for vulnerabilities.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT VULNERABILITY_TYPE FROM QRTZ_JOB_SECURITY_REPORTS WHERE SCHED_NAME = 'SpringBatch_TrainMonitor'   AND SEVERITY_LEVEL = 'Critical';

question: Which components have the most warning events? List the component ID and the count of its records where the status is 'WARNING'.
evidence: 'Component' refers to the monitored metric or service. 'Status' indicates the current health state, such as 'WARNING', 'OK', or 'CRITICAL'.
SQL: SELECT id_metric, COUNT(*) AS warning_count FROM data_bin WHERE status = 'WARNING' GROUP BY id_metric ORDER BY warning_count DESC;

question: Which components had failed upgrades? List each component's name, its target version, and the failure result summary.
evidence: Failed upgrade: execution log status indicates failure.
SQL: SELECT      uc.component_name,     up.target_version,     u.result_summary FROM upgradable_components uc JOIN upgrade_plans up ON uc.id = up.component_id JOIN upgrades u ON up.id = u.plan_id WHERE u.status = 'failed';

question: List the names and salaries of all staff members currently employed as Senior Stylists.
evidence: Position title is exactly 'Senior Stylist'. Salary refers to current compensation.
SQL: SELECT staff_name, staff_salary FROM STAFF WHERE staff_position = 'Senior Stylist';

question: Which backup version names correspond to jobs with a status of 'CANCELLED'?
evidence: Backup versions are linked to jobs via the job identifier. 'CANCELLED' is the specific status value for failed or stopped jobs.
SQL: SELECT bv.version_name FROM garmadon_backup_version bv JOIN garmadon_backup_job bj ON bv.backup_id = bj.id WHERE bj.status = 'CANCELLED';

question: What are the metric names and their corresponding alert thresholds for all alarms defined within the Azure RouteTracker monitoring namespace?
evidence: The Azure/RouteTracker namespace groups monitoring resources for route tracking services. Metric names identify the specific performance data points being tracked.
SQL: SELECT metricname, threshold FROM alarm WHERE namespace = 'Azure/RouteTracker';

question: Which partition IDs have the 'mapreduce.job.reduces' parameter, and what are their configured values for map reduce task settings?
evidence: 'mapreduce.job.reduces' is a configuration property controlling the number of reduce tasks in MapReduce jobs.
SQL: SELECT PART_ID, PARAM_VALUE FROM PARTITION_PARAMS WHERE PARAM_KEY = 'mapreduce.job.reduces'

question: Which metrics have reached a CRITICAL status, and what was their highest recorded value?
evidence: CRITICAL is a severity status. Peak severity is the maximum recorded value for that metric.
SQL: SELECT id_metric, MAX(value) AS max_value FROM data_bin WHERE id_metric IN (SELECT DISTINCT id_metric FROM data_bin WHERE status = 'CRITICAL') GROUP BY id_metric ORDER BY id_metric;

question: Which backup jobs are currently pending, and what are their unique identifiers and scheduled start times?
evidence: Pending status indicates jobs queued for processing but not yet started. Start time is the scheduled execution timestamp.
SQL: SELECT id, start_time FROM garmadon_backup_job WHERE status = 'PENDING'

question: Which users registered in Germany have logged in at least once? List their usernames.
evidence: Registered in Germany means the user's profile country field is 'Germany'. Logged in means at least one login record exists.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT u.username FROM gf_user u INNER JOIN gf_user_activity a ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE u.country = 'Germany'

question: Which users have logged a happy mood? Provide their names and cities, ordered alphabetically by name.
evidence: Happy mood is a specific entry in the mood logs. Names are sorted A-Z.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT u.name, u.city FROM user u INNER JOIN user_mood_logs uml ON u.id = uml.id_user WHERE uml.mood = 'happy' ORDER BY u.name ASC;

question: Which clusters have a 'backup_schedule' tag and at least one extension activated after January 1, 2023? For these clusters, list the name and the count of distinct features.
evidence: Extension activation date is stored in extension_activation_date. Feature count is distinct_features_count.
SQL: SELECT c.cluster_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.feature_name) AS feature_count FROM clusters c INNER JOIN features f ON c.cluster_id = f.cluster_id WHERE c.cluster_id IN (     SELECT DISTINCT cluster_id FROM cluster_extensions WHERE activation_time > '2023-01-01' ) AND c.cluster_id IN (     SELECT DISTINCT cluster_id FROM ClusterMetadataTags WHERE tag_name = 'backup_schedule' ) GROUP BY c.cluster_id, c.cluster_name

question: List the names and descriptions of all active cancellation reasons categorized under 'Fraude'.
evidence: Active means status is 'Active'. 'Fraude' is the specific category name for fraud-related reasons.
SQL: SELECT nombre, descripcion FROM T_CATALOGO_MOTIVOS_CANCELACION WHERE categoria = 'Fraude'   AND activo = 'S';

question: Provide the ID and changelog entry count for each model version that includes at least one entry marked as deployment ready.
evidence: Changelog entry type 'DEPLOYMENT_READY' indicates a version is approved for release. Count all entries per version.
SQL: SELECT modelVersionId, COUNT(*) as changelog_count FROM ModelVersionChangelog WHERE changeType = 'DEPLOYMENT_READY' GROUP BY modelVersionId ORDER BY modelVersionId

question: Which exam centers conduct interviews, and how many inspection reports has each center filed?
evidence: Examination method 'Vấn đáp' refers to interviews. Inspection reports are distinct records filed against centers.
SQL: SELECT      d.TenCumThi,     COUNT(cir.report_id) AS total_reports FROM dscumthi d JOIN cumthi_phuong_thuc pt ON d.MaCT = pt.MaCT JOIN cumthi_inspection_reports cir ON d.MaCT = cir.MaCT WHERE pt.PhuongThucThi = 'Vấn đáp' GROUP BY d.MaCT, d.TenCumThi ORDER BY d.TenCumThi;

question: What are the file paths and resolution details for all images stored in the JPEG format?
evidence: JPEG refers to the standard image file format. Resolution is defined by width and height in pixels.
SQL: SELECT i.img_path, im.resolution FROM image i JOIN image_metadata im ON i.id = im.image_id WHERE im.image_format = 'JPEG';

question: Which user ID is linked to the audit log entry recording a 'CANCELLATION_REQUESTED' action?
evidence: 'CANCELLATION_REQUESTED' is the specific action type string stored in the audit log records.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT user_userid FROM auditlog WHERE action = 'CANCELLATION_REQUESTED'

question: What was the performance value recorded for metric 6 when its status was 'WARNING'?
evidence: Metric ID 6 corresponds to a specific system performance indicator. Status 'WARNING' indicates the metric exceeded a predefined threshold.
SQL: SELECT value FROM data_bin WHERE id_metric = 6 AND status = 'WARNING';

question: Retrieve the message text and severity level for every integration log entry recorded with an error severity.
evidence: Log level 'ERROR' indicates critical failures requiring immediate attention. Integration logs track system-to-system communication events.
SQL: SELECT message, log_level FROM table_integration_logs WHERE log_level = 'ERROR'

question: Which users with status 3 have registered a hardware key as their multi-factor authentication device, and what are their usernames and device names?
evidence: Status 3 indicates suspended accounts. Hardware keys are a type of multi-factor authentication device.
SQL: SELECT u.username, d.device_name FROM users u JOIN user_mfa_devices d ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE u.status = 3   AND d.device_type = 'hardware_key';

question: Which customers prefer Norwegian Elkhounds for food, and what are the specific notes on this preference?
evidence: Preference type 'Food' refers to dietary needs. Breed 'Norwegian Elkhound' is a specific dog breed.
SQL: SELECT c.name, cp.notes FROM Customer c JOIN CustomerPreference cp ON c.ownerShipId = cp.ownerShipId JOIN Breed b ON cp.breedId = b.breedId WHERE cp.preferenceType = 'Food'   AND b.breedName = 'Norwegian Elkhound'

question: What are the current status and value for metric ID 38, specifically highlighting any warnings or critical alerts?
evidence: Metric ID 38 is a performance indicator. Status values include 'warning' and 'critical' for alerts.
SQL: SELECT status, value FROM data_bin WHERE id_metric = 38 AND status IN ('WARNING', 'CRITICAL')

question: What is the message and scheduled time for notification ID 337, which was triggered by the user with email riches.thibault@orange.fr?
evidence: Notification ID 337 refers to a specific system alert. Triggered by user email identifies the responsible party.
SQL: SELECT notification_message, scheduled_at FROM automated_notifications WHERE notification_id = 337 AND triggered_by = 'riches.thibault@orange.fr'

question: Which clusters have a metadata tag named 'backup_schedule' set to 'weekly_sunday'? Please provide their unique identifiers and names.
evidence: Clusters are infrastructure units. Metadata tags are key-value pairs. Unique identifier is the primary key.
SQL: SELECT c.cluster_id, c.cluster_name FROM clusters c JOIN ClusterMetadataTags t ON c.cluster_id = t.cluster_id WHERE t.tag_name = 'backup_schedule' AND t.tag_value = 'weekly_sunday'

question: Which exam centers used the 'Combined multiple choice and essay' method and have inspection reports filed after December 1, 2021? List the center name, method, and most recent inspection date.
evidence: Examination method 'Kết hợp trắc nghiệm và tự luận' means 'Combined multiple choice and essay'. Inspection reports are filed by date.
SQL: SELECT      d.TenCumThi,     p.PhuongThucThi,     MAX(i.inspection_date) AS most_recent_inspection_date FROM dscumthi d JOIN cumthi_phuong_thuc p ON d.MaCT = p.MaCT JOIN cumthi_inspection_reports i ON d.MaCT = i.MaCT WHERE p.PhuongThucThi = 'Kết hợp trắc nghiệm và tự luận'     AND i.inspection_date > '2021-12-01' GROUP BY d.MaCT, d.TenCumThi, p.PhuongThucThi;

question: List the full names and email addresses of all employees who received a 'Very Good' appraisal rating in the log.
evidence: 'Appraisal log' records employee performance evaluations. 'Very Good' is a specific rating category within the evaluation system.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT     e.FIRST_NAME,     e.LAST_NAME,     e.EMAIL FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN APRAISAL_LOG a ON e.EMPLOYEE_ID = a.EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE a.RATING = 'Very Good';

question: Which metric ID recorded the highest performance value among all items currently in a WARNING status?
evidence: Performance value is a numeric metric. WARNING is a specific status string indicating a degraded but not critical state.
SQL: SELECT id_metric, value FROM data_bin WHERE status = 'WARNING' AND value = (SELECT MAX(value) FROM data_bin WHERE status = 'WARNING')

question: What feedback text and timestamps are currently reported for the 'vape-mix-mobile-ios' application?
evidence: Application name is exactly 'vape-mix-mobile-ios'. Feedback includes text and timestamp fields.
SQL: SELECT feedback, timestamp FROM user_feedback WHERE application = 'vape-mix-mobile-ios'

question: Which test cases have error logs and were included in impact analyses for code changes marked with high severity?
evidence: Impact severity is categorized as High, Medium, or Low. Error logs are records of test failures.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT tcel.test_case_reference FROM test_case_error_logs tcel INNER JOIN code_change_impact_analysis ccia   ON tcel.test_case_reference = ccia.test_case_reference WHERE ccia.impact_severity = 'High' ORDER BY tcel.test_case_reference;

question: What is the access level value for the event log entry identified by persistence ID evt-000f000f000f000f-06b4 and sequence number 1?
evidence: The access level corresponds to the tag value associated with the access_level tag key for the specified event log entry.
SQL: SELECT tag_value FROM event_tagging WHERE persistence_id = 'evt-000f000f000f000f-06b4' AND sequence_number = 1 AND tag_key = 'access_level'

question: Show the account ID, transaction description, and memo for completed scheduled transactions with a refresh rate exceeding 10.
evidence: Scheduled transactions are recurring entries. Refresh rate is a numeric frequency value. Completed status indicates finalized transactions.
SQL: SELECT st.account_id, st.description, tm.memo_text FROM scheduled_transaction st JOIN transaction_memo tm ON st.schedule_id = tm.transaction_id WHERE st.status = 'completed' AND tm.refresh_rate > 10

question: What are the benefit names and coverage amounts for all benefits associated with the Accidental Death Policy?
evidence: Benefits are linked to policies. Coverage amount is the monetary limit protected by the benefit.
SQL: SELECT benefit_name, coverage_amount FROM tbl_benefits_overview WHERE policy_parent_label = 'Accidental Death Policy';

question: Which exam centers use 'Thực hành' as a testing method, and what specific components are associated with each of those centers?
evidence: 'Thực hành' translates to 'Practical'. Testing methods and components are linked attributes of an exam center.
SQL: SELECT d.TenCumThi, c.TenThanhPhanChi FROM dscumthi d JOIN cumthi_phuong_thuc p ON d.MaCT = p.MaCT JOIN cumthi_thanhphanchi c ON d.MaCT = c.MaCT WHERE p.PhuongThucThi = 'Thực hành' ORDER BY d.TenCumThi, c.TenThanhPhanChi

question: Which exam center uses the 'Luận văn tốt nghiệp' testing method?
evidence: Testing method 'Luận văn tốt nghiệp' refers to graduation thesis evaluation.
SQL: SELECT d.TenCumThi FROM dscumthi d JOIN cumthi_phuong_thuc c ON d.MaCT = c.MaCT WHERE c.PhuongThucThi = 'Luận văn tốt nghiệp'

question: Identify the distinct user identifiers associated with feedback submissions specifically for the 'vape-mix-mobile-ios' application.
evidence: Feedback records link users to applications via a submission relationship; distinct IDs ensure no duplicates.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_feedback WHERE application = 'vape-mix-mobile-ios';

question: Which test plans have at least one execution record with a status of 'COMPLETED'?
evidence: Test plans are projects tracked by their execution records. A status of 'COMPLETED' indicates a finished execution.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT tp.name FROM testplan tp JOIN testplan_execution tpe ON tp.id = tpe.testplan_id WHERE tpe.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY tp.name;

question: Which users requested approval for documents later updated with 'update_rental_period', showing their request status, change date, and new value?
evidence: Change type 'update_rental_period' modifies rental duration. New value is the updated duration. Request status indicates approval outcome.
SQL: SELECT      fu.username,     ar.status,     dh.change_date,     dh.new_value FROM fos_user fu JOIN approval_request ar ON fu.id = ar.user_id JOIN doc_history dh ON ar.doc_id = dh.doc_id WHERE dh.change_type = 'update_rental_period'

question: Which tags are associated with media files uploaded by moderators, and how many files does each tag cover?
evidence: Moderators are users with the 'moderator' role. Tags are labels applied to media files.
SQL: SELECT t.title, COUNT(m.id) AS file_count FROM tags t JOIN media_tags mt ON t.id = mt.tag_id JOIN media m ON mt.media_id = m.id JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE u.role = 'moderator' GROUP BY t.id, t.title ORDER BY t.title;

question: Which test plan executions failed, including their scheduled start, actual end times, and the specific test case descriptions to analyze failure patterns?
evidence: Failed means status is 'FAILED'. Scheduled time is start time. Actual end time is completion time.
SQL: SELECT      tpe.id AS execution_id,     tpe.scheduled_time,     tpe.actual_end,     tc.description AS testcase_description FROM testplan_execution tpe JOIN testplan tp ON tpe.testplan_id = tp.id JOIN testplan_items tpi ON tpe.testplan_id = tpi.testplan_id JOIN testcase tc ON tpi.testcase_name = tc.name WHERE tpe.status = 'FAILED'

question: How many pending team invitations exist for each client who has submitted a review with a rating below three?
evidence: Pending invitations are those with status 'Pending'. Low satisfaction is defined by a review rating strictly less than 3.
SQL: SELECT ti.invitee_client_id, COUNT(*) AS pending_invitations FROM team_invitation ti INNER JOIN task_review tr ON ti.invitee_client_id = tr.reviewer_client_id WHERE ti.status = 'Pending'   AND tr.rating < 3 GROUP BY ti.invitee_client_id ORDER BY ti.invitee_client_id

question: Provide the full names and email addresses for all individuals assigned the standard 'user' role within the system.
evidence: 'User' is the default role for standard customers, distinct from administrative or privileged roles.
SQL: SELECT name, email FROM users WHERE role = 'user';

question: Which orders have pending conversations where the customer's message was sent after February 1, 2023? Include the order ID and message text.
evidence: Conversations link customers to orders. Status 'Pending' indicates unresolved support tickets. Messages are timestamped records of customer communication.
SQL: SELECT order_id, customer_message FROM order_conversation WHERE status = 'Pending'   AND customer_message_at > '2023-02-01'

question: Please provide the start and end dates for agent records that are currently in an in-progress status.
evidence: Agent records track operational lifecycles. Status 'IN_PROGRESS' indicates active, ongoing tasks requiring date boundaries.
SQL: SELECT SDATE, EDATE FROM FIXFLOW_AGENT_AGENTINFO WHERE STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS'

question: Which users updated pricing, and on what dates did these changes occur with which new values?
evidence: Change type 'update_pricing' refers specifically to modifications in the price field of document records.
SQL: SELECT f.username, dh.change_date, dh.new_value FROM doc_history dh JOIN fos_user f ON dh.changed_by = f.id WHERE dh.change_type = 'update_pricing';

question: What is the current configuration value for the PRODUCT_STATUS_OVERRIDE rule in blockchain chain 58?
evidence: PRODUCT_STATUS_OVERRIDE is a rule key determining product status settings within a specific blockchain chain.
SQL: SELECT chnrl_rulevalue FROM chainrule WHERE chnrl_chn_chainid = 58 AND chnrl_rulekey = 'PRODUCT_STATUS_OVERRIDE'

question: Which monsters defeated any player in combat encounters?
evidence: Defeat means the player's HP reached zero. Monsters are entities fought by players.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT monster_name FROM monster_encounters WHERE encounter_outcome = 'Defeat';

question: Which application has the most ApplicationScaledUp events across all its tenants, and what is that total count?
evidence: ApplicationScaledUp: event indicating successful vertical scaling of an application instance.
SQL: SELECT      a.Name AS ApplicationName,     COUNT(*) AS TotalScaledUpEvents FROM Application a JOIN Tenant t ON a.Id = t.ApplicationId JOIN TenantActivity ta ON t.Id = ta.TenantId WHERE ta.ActivityType = 'ApplicationScaledUp' GROUP BY a.Id, a.Name ORDER BY TotalScaledUpEvents DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many support ticket conversations are currently recorded with a status of 'Pending'?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_conversation WHERE status = 'Pending'

question: Which users live in Toulouse? Please provide their full name, gender, and city.
evidence: City is Toulouse. Fields are full name, gender, and city.
SQL: SELECT FNAME, SNAME, GENGER, CITY FROM USERS WHERE CITY = 'Toulouse';

question: Which SCI students have a father, owe less than 100, and are enrolled in at least two courses?
evidence: Fee amount is numeric currency. Enrolled in course means active registration.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT s.Name FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.Roll_No = e.StudentRollNo JOIN student_fees sf ON s.Roll_No = sf.StudentRollNo JOIN student_parents sp ON s.Roll_No = sp.StudentRollNo WHERE s.Branch = 'SCI'   AND sf.Amount < 100.00   AND sp.Relation = 'Father'   AND (     SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.CourseId)     FROM enrollment e2     WHERE e2.StudentRollNo = s.Roll_No   ) >= 2

question: List the names and access control types for all resources identified as LDAP entries to support directory security mapping.
evidence: LDAP_ENTRY is a resource type representing directory entries. Access control type defines the permission level for that resource.
SQL: SELECT RESOURCE_NAME, ACCESS_CONTROL_TYPE FROM JCFIAM_RESOURCE_ACCESS_CONTROLS WHERE RESOURCE_TYPE = 'LDAP_ENTRY';

question: What is the average user rating for feedback associated with deliveries marked as cancelled?
evidence: User rating refers to the score in feedback records. Delivery status 'cancelled' identifies the specific subset of transactions.
SQL: SELECT AVG(df.user_rating) AS avg_user_rating FROM delivery d JOIN delivery_feedback df ON d.delivery_id = df.delivery_id WHERE d.status = 'cancelled'

question: Which Elite High-Frequency subscribers have at least one approved document approval request, and what is their count of distinct form submissions?
evidence: Form submissions are distinct by ID. Approved requests require status 'Approved' and user existence in the subscription plan.
SQL: SELECT ufs.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ufs.form_id) AS distinct_form_count FROM user_form_submissions ufs WHERE ufs.user_id IN (     SELECT DISTINCT usp.user_id     FROM user_subscription_plans usp     INNER JOIN user_document_approvals uda ON usp.user_id = uda.user_id     WHERE usp.plan_name = 'Elite High-Frequency'       AND uda.approved = 1 ) GROUP BY ufs.user_id

question: Which refund reasons have the highest total processed amounts for approved refunds?
evidence: Refund status 'Approved' means the refund was finalized. Sum includes all processed amounts.
SQL: SELECT reason, SUM(amount) as total_refund_amount FROM Refunds WHERE refundStatus = 'Approved' GROUP BY reason ORDER BY total_refund_amount DESC;

question: Which projects rely on Finish-to-Start dependencies, ensuring strict sequencing where one task must complete before the next can start?
evidence: Finish-to-Start means Task B cannot begin until Task A finishes, enforcing strict chronological sequencing.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.PB_NAME FROM PB_PROJECT_DEPENDENCY d JOIN PB_PROJECT p ON p.PB_ID = d.PB_DEPENDENT_PROJECT_ID WHERE d.PB_DEPENDENCY_TYPE = 'Finish-to-Start' ORDER BY p.PB_NAME

question: Which custom fields are currently active and designated as text type, to help validate data entry forms for new project attributes?
evidence: Active means status is enabled. Field type 'TEXT' refers to free-form text inputs, not numbers or dates.
SQL: SELECT NAME FROM PLM_CUSTOM_FIELD_DEFINITION WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND FIELD_TYPE = 'TEXT'

question: Show the dispute ID, type, and subject for all disputes that are currently open.
evidence: Dispute status 'open' indicates unresolved issues pending review or action.
SQL: SELECT dispute_id, dispute_type, subject FROM user_dispute_logs WHERE status = 'open';

question: List test cases depending on others, showing their name, success status, and count of ERROR-level log messages.
evidence: A test case depends on another if it has at least one dependency. Severity 'ERROR' indicates critical log entries.
SQL: SELECT      tc.name,     tc.success,     COUNT(CASE WHEN tcl.log_severity = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) AS error_count FROM test_case_dependencies tcd JOIN test_cases tc ON tcd.test_case_id = tc.id LEFT JOIN test_case_logs tcl ON tc.id = tcl.test_case_id GROUP BY tc.id, tc.name, tc.success

question: Which tenants have recorded user logout events, and what is the total count of these 'UserLoggedOut' activities for each?
evidence: 'UserLoggedOut' indicates a session termination event. Count excludes tenants with zero occurrences.
SQL: SELECT      t.Name AS TenantName,     COUNT(*) AS LogoutCount FROM Tenant t INNER JOIN TenantActivity ta ON t.Id = ta.TenantId WHERE ta.ActivityType = 'UserLoggedOut' GROUP BY t.Id, t.Name ORDER BY LogoutCount DESC;

question: List all pending shift suggestions for the 'International Vocabulary Acquisition Team' involving the day shift.
evidence: Department 28 is 'International Vocabulary Acquisition Team'. Status 'pending' means awaiting review. Shift 'day' is the specific shift type.
SQL: SELECT ss.* FROM shift_suggestion ss JOIN department d ON ss.department_id = d.id WHERE d.name = 'International Vocabulary Acquisition Team'   AND ss.status = 'pending'   AND ss.SHIFT = 'day'

question: When were tasks reassigned? List the task ID and event time for every history record where the event type was 'TASK_REASSIGNED'.
evidence: TASK_REASSIGNED indicates a task was moved to a different user. History records track all state changes.
SQL: SELECT task_id, event_time FROM act_task_history WHERE event_type = 'TASK_REASSIGNED';

question: List the names of all active projects and their primary communication channels to ensure every active initiative has a designated discussion space.
evidence: 'Active' refers to the current status of a project. 'Primary communication channel' is the main discussion space assigned to each project.
SQL: SELECT p.name AS project_name, cc.channel_name FROM project p JOIN project_status ps ON p.id = ps.project_id JOIN communication_channel cc ON p.id = cc.project_id WHERE ps.status = 'Active' ORDER BY p.name

question: Which employees are Technical Writers or Full Stack Developers with travel permits pending management approval?
evidence: Travel permit status 'Under Management Approval' indicates pending review. Employee roles include Technical Writer and Full Stack Developer.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT e.ename FROM emp e JOIN travel_permit_statuses tps ON e.empno = tps.empno JOIN travel_expenses te ON tps.travel_request_id = te.te_id WHERE tps.permit_status = 'Under Management Approval'   AND e.job IN ('Technical Writer', 'Full Stack Developer');

question: List the names and descriptions of all network templates that are currently active, meaning their backend status is 'registered' and they have not been deleted.
evidence: Active network templates have a backend status of 'registered' and are not marked as deleted.
SQL: SELECT name, description FROM core_networktemplate WHERE backend_status = 'registered' AND deleted = 0;

question: What is the token and expiration time for the current session of the user with directory ID pers-0001?
evidence: Active session means the current valid session for a user. Directory ID uniquely identifies a person in the system.
SQL: SELECT token_value, expires_at FROM session_token WHERE directory__person_id = 'pers-0001'   AND status = 'active';

question: Identify the user ID, timestamp, and IP address for every instance where the EVALUATE_DECISION_TABLE audit action was recorded.
evidence: EVALUATE_DECISION_TABLE refers to the specific audit event type for decision table evaluation within the Flowable engine.
SQL: SELECT USER_ID_, ACTION_TIME_, IP_ADDRESS_ FROM ACT_DMN_AUDIT_LOG WHERE ACTION_ = 'EVALUATE_DECISION_TABLE'

question: What are the user IDs and total discount values for users holding at least one FIXED_FEE_WAIVER type discount code?
evidence: FIXED_FEE_WAIVER is a specific discount code type. Total value is the sum of all discount values for that user.
SQL: SELECT user_id, SUM(discount_value) AS total_discount_value FROM user_discounts WHERE discount_type = 'FIXED_FEE_WAIVER' GROUP BY user_id;

question: What is the user ID and hit count for relationship 25 where the usage marker is 'BA_SOKNAD_INNSendt'?
evidence: The usage marker 'BA_SOKNAD_INNSendt' indicates a submitted application. Hits refer to recorded usage log entries.
SQL: SELECT BRUKER_ID, TREFF_COUNT  FROM KODELISTE_RELASJON_BRUK_HIT_LOG  WHERE RELASJON_ID = 25    AND BRUKS_MERKER = 'BA_SOKNAD_INNSendt'

question: Which applications have experienced an ApplicationScaledUp event for at least one of their tenants, and what are their names?
evidence: ApplicationScaledUp indicates a tenant's resource allocation was increased. 'At least one tenant' requires checking all tenants per application.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT a.Name FROM Application a JOIN Tenant t ON a.Id = t.ApplicationId JOIN TenantActivity ta ON t.Id = ta.TenantId WHERE ta.ActivityType = 'ApplicationScaledUp';

question: List order ID, total amount, and invoice status for orders with a failed refund and an unpaid invoice, sorted by total amount descending.
evidence: Refund status 'Failed' indicates a returned payment attempt. Invoice status 'Unpaid' indicates outstanding balance.
SQL: SELECT o.id, o.total, i.status FROM Orders o INNER JOIN Refunds r ON o.id = r.orderId INNER JOIN Invoices i ON o.id = i.orderId WHERE r.refundStatus = 'Failed'   AND i.status = 'Unpaid' ORDER BY o.total DESC;

question: Which tenants have a 'TenantCreated' event? For each, provide the tenant name, scaling factor, and creation timestamp.
evidence: Active tenants are those with recorded activity. Scaling factor is a numeric configuration value.
SQL: SELECT t.Name, t.ScalingFactor, ta.Timestamp FROM Tenant t JOIN TenantActivity ta ON t.Id = ta.TenantId WHERE ta.ActivityType = 'TenantCreated'

question: What is the ID and name of the test plan named 'Influencer Partnership Tool' that is currently pending?
evidence: Test plan status 'PENDING' indicates it is awaiting approval or execution.
SQL: SELECT t.id, t.name  FROM testplan t JOIN testplan_execution te ON t.id = te.testplan_id WHERE te.status = 'PENDING'   AND t.name = 'Influencer Partnership Tool'

question: Identify students enrolled in multiple courses who have a fee exceeding $100 and whose father is listed as a guardian.
evidence: Multiple courses: count > 1. Fee exceeding $100: amount > 100.00. Father listed: relation equals 'Father'.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT s.Name FROM student s JOIN enrollment e ON s.Roll_No = e.StudentRollNo JOIN student_fees sf ON s.Roll_No = sf.StudentRollNo JOIN student_parents sp ON s.Roll_No = sp.StudentRollNo GROUP BY s.Roll_No, s.Name HAVING      COUNT(DISTINCT e.CourseId) > 1     AND SUM(CASE WHEN sf.Amount > 100.00 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1     AND SUM(CASE WHEN sp.Relation = 'Father' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1

question: Which clients have at least one pending team invitation?
evidence: Pending invites are those with status 'Pending'. Clients are identified by their login names.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT c.login FROM client c JOIN team_invitation ti ON c.id = ti.invitee_client_id WHERE ti.status = 'Pending';

question: List the real names and point totals for all players currently ranked in the Platinum division.
evidence: Rank indicates division level; points are cumulative score within that specific division tier.
SQL: SELECT p.real_name, pr.points FROM public_PlayerRank pr JOIN public_Player p ON pr.player_id = p.id WHERE pr.division = 'Platinum'

question: What is the success status and detail message for audit event audit-0093 performed by service_account_api_gateway?
evidence: Success status is a boolean. Detail message is the event description. Actor is the user performing the action.
SQL: SELECT success, details FROM system_operation_audit WHERE id = 'audit-0093' AND actor = 'service_account_api_gateway'

question: Which invoice IDs and total amounts correspond to billing records linked to charges that are currently marked as cancelled?
evidence: Charges with status 'Cancelled' are excluded from active operations. Billing records link invoices to these charges.
SQL: SELECT bi.InvoiceId, bi.TotalAmount FROM BillingInvoices bi JOIN Charges c ON bi.ChargeId = c.ChargeId WHERE c.Status = 'Cancelled';

question: Show the ID, type, and status of all jobs currently retrying.
evidence: Retrying means the job is actively being retried after a failure.
SQL: SELECT id, type, status FROM job WHERE status = 'retrying'

question: For session sess_0061_309992, what are the total memory usage time and the peak memory resource value recorded in the activity statistics?
evidence: Memory usage time is cumulative duration; peak value is the maximum recorded resource consumption.
SQL: SELECT total_time, peak_usage FROM resource_usage_stat WHERE session_id = 'sess_0061_309992'   AND resource_type = 'memory';

question: List the transaction group ID and retry policy for all FIXED_DELAY retry types, sorted by group ID ascending.
evidence: FIXED_DELAY is a retry strategy type. Transaction group ID uniquely identifies a group of related transactions.
SQL: SELECT TXNvwdfgsdfxGroupBxID, RetryPolicy FROM TXNvwdfgsdfxRetries WHERE RetryType = 'FIXED_DELAY' ORDER BY TXNvwdfgsdfxGroupBxID ASC;

question: Which students have disbursed financial aid and an enrollment limit exceeding 10 credits?
evidence: Disbursed means aid is paid. Enrollment limit is the max credits allowed per course.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT fal.StudentStudentId FROM FinancialAidRecords fal JOIN StudentCourseEnrollmentLimits scl ON fal.StudentStudentId = scl.StudentStudentId WHERE fal.Status = 'Disbursed'   AND scl.MaxEnrollments > 10;

question: How many distinct retry policies are associated with transaction groups configured with an exponential backoff retry type?
evidence: Retry type 'EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF' filters the transaction groups. Distinct policies count unique policy identifiers per group.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RetryPolicy) AS distinct_retry_policy_count FROM TXNvwdfgsdfxRetries WHERE RetryType = 'EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF';

question: Which system components are currently undergoing maintenance? List the component name and its health status for all checks.
evidence: Health status 'MAINTENANCE' indicates a component is undergoing scheduled maintenance.
SQL: SELECT component, health_status FROM system_health_check_results WHERE health_status = 'MAINTENANCE';

question: Show ticket summaries, statuses, and resolving agent IDs for tickets marked as 'Pending Customer Response' that have also been resolved.
evidence: 'Resolved' indicates final action taken. 'Pending Customer Response' is a specific status label requiring follow-up.
SQL: SELECT c.summary, c.status, r.agent_id FROM customer_service_ticket c JOIN customer_service_ticket_resolution r ON c.ticket_id = r.ticket_id WHERE c.status = 'Pending Customer Response'

question: Which distinct external organizations have established a 'Patient Recruitment Partnership' for clinical studies to support future outreach initiatives?
evidence: 'Patient Recruitment Partnership' is a specific collaboration type. 'External organizations' refers to entities outside the primary healthcare provider network.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT external_organization FROM study_external_collaboration WHERE collaboration_type = 'Patient Recruitment Partnership' ORDER BY external_organization;

question: Which hardware component serial numbers and types were deployed using Bathymetric Survey elevation methods?
evidence: Bathymetric Survey is a specific elevation determination method used during receiver deployment.
SQL: SELECT hc.serial_number, hc.component_type FROM otnunit_hardware_components hc JOIN otnunit_additional_geolocation ag   ON hc.deployment_id = ag.deployment_id WHERE ag.elevation_method = 'Bathymetric Survey';

question: Which active staff member holds Admin access rights, and what are their user ID, access level, and status?
evidence: Active means status is 'Aktif'. Admin is the specific hak_akses value for administrative privileges.
SQL: SELECT id_user, hak_akses, status FROM tb_user WHERE hak_akses = 'Admin' AND status = 'Aktif';

question: Which car models have leads from 'Online Ad Click' that have been reviewed and have an associated cost?
evidence: Lead origin 'Online Ad Click' refers to traffic source. Reviewed means a review record exists. Cost must be non-null.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM carLead cl JOIN car c ON cl.carId = c.id WHERE cl.leadSource = 'Online Ad Click'   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM carLeadReview clr WHERE clr.carLeadId = cl.id)   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM carLeadCost clc WHERE clc.carLeadId = cl.id) ORDER BY c.name;

question: What is the description of the transformation logic for the rule that converts data from Excel format to SQL format?
evidence: Transformation logic describes how source data fields map and change during format conversion.
SQL: SELECT TRANSFORMATION_LOGIC  FROM CONVERSION_RULE  WHERE SOURCE_FORMAT = 'Excel' AND TARGET_FORMAT = 'SQL'

question: How many total hours did students with an 'ENROLLMENT_ADD' adjustment log during their internship?
evidence: ENROLLMENT_ADD is a specific enrollment adjustment type. Internship engagement is measured by logged hours.
SQL: SELECT      SUM(sil.hours_logged) AS total_hours FROM course_offering_enrollment_adjustment cea JOIN student_internship_log sil ON cea.student_id = sil.student_id WHERE cea.adjustment_type = 'ENROLLMENT_ADD'

question: Which admins have created monitoring items and currently handle open support chats? List their usernames, current open chat counts, and total create action counts.
evidence: Create actions refer to monitoring item creation. Open chats are support tickets with status 'Open'.
SQL: SELECT      a.s_username,     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_support_chats csc WHERE csc.admin_id = a.id AND csc.chat_status = 'open') AS open_chat_count,     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actions_log al WHERE al.user_id = a.id AND al.action_type = 'create') AS create_action_count FROM admin a WHERE EXISTS (     SELECT 1 FROM actions_log al WHERE al.user_id = a.id AND al.action_type = 'create' ) AND EXISTS (     SELECT 1 FROM customer_support_chats csc WHERE csc.admin_id = a.id AND csc.chat_status = 'open' ) ORDER BY a.s_username

question: For job instance 29, what was the original value and override time for the THRESHOLD_ERROR_RATE environment parameter?
evidence: Job instance 29 refers to the specific batch execution ID. THRESHOLD_ERROR_RATE is a configurable environment parameter.
SQL: SELECT ORIGINAL_VALUE, OVERRIDE_TIME  FROM REMOTE_PARTITION_ENV_OVERRIDES  WHERE ENV_NAME = 'THRESHOLD_ERROR_RATE'    AND JOB_INSTANCE_ID = 29

question: Retrieve the component name and full audit details for all records categorized as 'Pod Restart Event' to support infrastructure stability investigations.
evidence: Audit type 'Pod Restart Event' indicates a container restart. Component name refers to the system service name.
SQL: SELECT system_component, details FROM system_audits WHERE audit_type = 'Pod Restart Event';

question: What were the original and overridden values for the DB_CONNECTION_POOL_SIZE environment parameter in job instance 79?
evidence: DB_CONNECTION_POOL_SIZE is an environment parameter. Job instance ID 79 identifies the specific execution context.
SQL: SELECT ORIGINAL_VALUE, OVERRIDDEN_VALUE  FROM REMOTE_PARTITION_ENV_OVERRIDES  WHERE JOB_INSTANCE_ID = 79    AND ENV_NAME = 'DB_CONNECTION_POOL_SIZE'

question: What are the summary and priority for all customer service tickets currently awaiting a response from the customer?
evidence: "Pending Customer Response" is the specific ticket status indicating the support team is waiting for the client to reply.
SQL: SELECT summary, priority FROM customer_service_ticket WHERE status = 'Pending Customer Response';

question: What is the average API response time for calls flagged with the 'error_rate_limit_exceeded' status, broken down by system code?
evidence: error_rate_limit_exceeded: HTTP 429 status. System code: unique identifier for the subsystem handling the request.
SQL: SELECT      e.system_code,     AVG(a.processing_time_ms) AS avg_processing_time_ms FROM external_api_logs e JOIN api_response_analysis a ON e.id = a.log_id WHERE a.status_category = 'error_rate_limit_exceeded' GROUP BY e.system_code ORDER BY avg_processing_time_ms DESC;

question: What is the name and current location of the Mango Burst item that is currently in Draft status?
evidence: Draft status indicates the item is not yet published or finalized for public distribution.
SQL: SELECT name, location FROM item WHERE name = 'Mango Burst' AND status = 'Draft'

question: Which unique IP addresses executed delete actions on the monitoring infrastructure, and what were the specific descriptions of the deleted items for each event?
evidence: Delete actions refer to record removal events. Monitoring infrastructure includes all managed network devices and services.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT ip_address, action_description FROM actions_log WHERE action_type = 'delete' ORDER BY ip_address

question: Which organizations have at least one active constraint group with mandatory enforcement, indicating strict non-negotiable financial controls?
evidence: Active means status is 'active'. Mandatory enforcement level implies strict, non-negotiable controls.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT o.name FROM gl_organization o JOIN gl_constraint_group cg ON o.id = cg.org_id WHERE cg.is_active = 1   AND cg.enforcement_level = 'mandatory';

question: Which users have submitted at least one bulk order request that is currently in processing status?
evidence: Bulk orders are distinct from standard orders. Processing status indicates the order is being handled but not yet completed.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT u.name FROM users u JOIN bulk_order_requests bor ON u.id = bor.user_id WHERE bor.status = 'processing';

question: What are the nickname and phone number for member M00023 who currently has a pending account status?
evidence: Pending status indicates an account awaiting approval or verification.
SQL: SELECT nickname, telphone FROM t_members WHERE id = 'M00023' AND status = 'Pending';

question: List administrators who have created more than one item, sorted by their creation count from highest to lowest.
evidence: 'Create' actions refer to item creation events. 'Administrator' refers to the user account performing the action.
SQL: SELECT      a.id AS admin_id,     a.s_username,     COUNT(al.id) AS create_count FROM admin a JOIN actions_log al ON a.id = al.user_id WHERE al.action_type = 'create' GROUP BY a.id, a.s_username HAVING COUNT(al.id) > 1 ORDER BY create_count DESC;

question: Which car models are linked to leads from 'Online Ad Click' campaigns where the contact email ends with '@outlook.com'?
evidence: Contact info containing 'outlook.com' implies the email address ends with '@outlook.com'.
SQL: SELECT c.name FROM carLead cl JOIN car c ON cl.carId = c.id WHERE cl.leadSource = 'Online Ad Click'   AND cl.contactInfo LIKE '%outlook.com%'

question: List the names and locations of all items currently marked as active in the inventory system.
evidence: Active items are those with a status of 'Active' in the inventory database.
SQL: SELECT name, location FROM item WHERE status = 'Active';

question: Calculate the total amount for all invoices associated with charges that have a status of 'Cancelled'.
evidence: Total amount is the sum of invoice line items. Charges link invoices to their processing status.
SQL: SELECT SUM(BillingInvoices.TotalAmount) AS total_sum FROM BillingInvoices JOIN Charges ON BillingInvoices.ChargeId = Charges.ChargeId WHERE Charges.Status = 'Cancelled';

question: For each system component, identify the first recorded timestamp when its health status was in maintenance.
evidence: Component refers to a system part. Health status 'MAINTENANCE' indicates scheduled downtime. Timestamp is the event time.
SQL: SELECT component, MIN(timestamp) AS earliest_timestamp FROM system_health_check_results WHERE health_status = 'MAINTENANCE' GROUP BY component ORDER BY earliest_timestamp;

question: Which distinct users have revoked API keys in the security audit trail?
evidence: The audit trail records operations; 'revoked API key' corresponds to the 'API_KEY_REVOKED' event type.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT username FROM user_audit_trail WHERE operation = 'API_KEY_REVOKED';

question: What is the total available weight in kilograms for the Barhi date variety sourced from Iran to check current stock levels?
evidence: Available weight refers to current inventory quantity. Barhi is a specific date variety. Sourced from Iran indicates the origin filter.
SQL: SELECT SUM(Ketersediaan_Kg) AS total_available_kg FROM stock WHERE Jenis_Kurma = 'Barhi'   AND Asal_Negara = 'Iran';

question: Show customer IDs and names for those who gave a punctuality rating of 4 or higher to a completed flight.
evidence: Completed flights have status 'Completed'. Punctuality rating is a discrete score from 1 to 5.
SQL: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN flight_segment_ratings fsr ON c.customer_id = fsr.customer_id JOIN flights f ON fsr.flight_id = f.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'Completed'   AND fsr.punctuality_rating >= 4

question: What is the total cost of custom expenses for the Logic Unit team within the Cloud Infrastructure category?
evidence: Custom expenses are non-standard line items. Logic Unit is the team name. Cloud Infrastructure is the expense category.
SQL: SELECT SUM(tce.amount) AS total_amount FROM team_custom_expenses tce JOIN teams t ON tce.teamid = t.id WHERE t.name = 'Logic Unit'   AND tce.category = 'Cloud Infrastructure'

question: Which leave types are configured with the specific approval workflow identified as 'APR-DIR-01'? Please list each type's unique identifier and its official title.
evidence: Leave types are administrative categories for employee time off. Approval ID 'APR-DIR-01' refers to a specific manager-level authorization rule.
SQL: SELECT id, title FROM leave_types WHERE approval_id = 'APR-DIR-01'

question: Which maintenance windows are assigned to host targets? List the names of all maintenance windows where the associated target is a host.
evidence: Target type 'host' refers to physical or virtual servers. Maintenance windows are scheduled periods for system updates or repairs.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT mw.name FROM maintenancewindows mw JOIN maintenancewindowtargets mwt ON mw.id = mwt.maintenancewindowid WHERE mwt.type = 'host';

question: Which clients have refunded payments? List their ID, the original payment amount, and the transaction ID for each refunded transaction.
evidence: Refunded payments are those with a status of 'refunded'. Original amount refers to the initial transaction value before refund.
SQL: SELECT user_id, amount, transaction_id FROM payment WHERE status = 'refunded';

question: Which service packages are actively subscribed to by tenants and enforce a bandwidth cap constraint?
evidence: Bandwidth cap constraint type is 'bandwidth_cap_mbps'. Active subscription means the entitlement is currently linked to a tenant.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT e.name FROM oc_entitlement e JOIN oc_entitlementconstraint ec ON e.entitlement_id = ec.entitlement_id JOIN oc_subscription s ON e.entitlement_id = s.entitlement_id WHERE ec.constraint_type = 'bandwidth_cap_mbps'   AND s.status = 'active';

question: Which leave type corresponds to approval ID 'APR-HR-01'? Return its unique identifier and title.
evidence: Approval ID 'APR-HR-01' links to a specific leave type record containing its ID and title.
SQL: SELECT id, title FROM leave_types WHERE approval_id = 'APR-HR-01'

question: Which institutions have active campus partnerships, and what collaboration scope is defined in those agreements?
evidence: Active campus partnerships are those with status 'Active'. Collaboration scope refers to the specific terms defined in the partnership agreement.
SQL: SELECT i.name, cp.collaboration_scope FROM campus_partnerships cp JOIN institutions i ON cp.partner_id = i.id WHERE cp.status = 'Active' ORDER BY i.name;

question: Provide the text and timestamp for all SERVICE_OK notifications to show recent service recoveries.
evidence: SERVICE_OK indicates a service has recovered from a previous error state.
SQL: SELECT message_content, sent_time FROM system_notifications WHERE message_type = 'SERVICE_OK';

question: Which plugins are in maintenance status but lack any active installation records?
evidence: Active installation means the plugin is currently installed and operational, not uninstalled or missing.
SQL: SELECT p.name FROM system_plugins p LEFT JOIN plugin_installations pi ON p.pluginid = pi.pluginid WHERE p.status = 'maintenance'   AND (pi.installid IS NULL OR pi.uninstalled_at IS NOT NULL)

question: Which enabled users have an ORDER_FILLED audit event and a registered desktop_client device?
evidence: ORDER_FILLED: trade execution event. desktop_client: specific device type. Enabled: account status active.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT u.username FROM users u INNER JOIN user_audit_trail uat ON u.username = uat.username INNER JOIN user_devices ud ON u.username = ud.username WHERE uat.operation = 'ORDER_FILLED'   AND ud.device_type = 'desktop_client'   AND u.enabled = 1;

question: Show the certificate number and issue date for training certificate INT-FIRE-606 issued to employee KY-311610.
evidence: Training ID 'INT-FIRE-606' refers to Fire Safety 606. Employee ID 'KY-311610' identifies the staff member.
SQL: SELECT tct_certificate_number, tct_issue_date FROM tbl_txn_training_certificates WHERE kry_no = 'KY-311610' AND trn_id = 'INT-FIRE-606'

question: Which teams spent over $100 on Cloud Infrastructure? List their name, bracket, and total spend, ordered by highest cost first.
evidence: Custom expenses are non-standard charges. Cloud Infrastructure is a specific expense category.
SQL: SELECT      t.name AS team_name,     t.bracket,     SUM(ce.amount) AS total_amount FROM team_custom_expenses ce JOIN teams t ON ce.teamid = t.id WHERE ce.category = 'Cloud Infrastructure' GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.bracket HAVING SUM(ce.amount) > 100 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

question: List the last name, ticket subject, and status for customers with pending or open support tickets related to shipping or address issues.
evidence: Support ticket categories include 'shipping' and 'address'. Valid statuses are 'Pending' and 'Open'.
SQL: SELECT      c.c_last,     cst.c_s_t_subject,     cst.c_s_t_status FROM customer c JOIN customer_support_ticket cst ON c.c_id = cst.c_s_t_c_id WHERE (LOWER(cst.c_s_t_subject) LIKE '%shipping%' OR LOWER(cst.c_s_t_subject) LIKE '%address%')   AND (cst.c_s_t_status = 'Open' OR cst.c_s_t_status = 'Pending')

question: Which passengers are enrolled in facial recognition security protocols based on their recorded biometric verification scans?
evidence: Facial recognition is a specific biometric scan type used for user identity verification and security protocol enrollment.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT p.Name FROM passenger p JOIN biometric_verification bv ON p.Pass_Num = bv.Pass_Num WHERE bv.ScanType = 'Facial Recognition';

question: What is the country of origin and predicted demand in kilograms for the 'Hala' date variety on October 6, 2024?
evidence: Predicted demand refers to the forecasted sales volume in kilograms for the specified date.
SQL: SELECT s.Asal_Negara, f.Predicted_Kg FROM stock s JOIN stock_demand_forecast f ON s.Id_Stock = f.Id_Stock WHERE s.Jenis_Kurma = 'Hala' AND f.Forecast_Date = '2024-10-06'

question: What are the license numbers and expiry dates for organizations holding a Workforce Analytics License?
evidence: License type 'Workforce Analytics License' identifies the specific category of organizational registration requiring compliance monitoring.
SQL: SELECT license_number, expiry_date  FROM organization_license  WHERE license_type = 'Workforce Analytics License';

question: Which user IDs have successfully completed data export requests?
evidence: Completed status means the export finished without errors.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM data_export_requests WHERE status = 'completed';

question: Which users had a job application deleted and then had the request to restore it rejected? I need their email addresses.
evidence: A deletion is linked to a restoration request. A rejected request means the application was not restored.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT u.email FROM public_deleted_app_restoration_requests r JOIN public_deleted_apps d ON r.deleted_app_id = d._id JOIN public_users u ON d.user_id = u._id WHERE r.request_status = 'rejected';

question: Which content suggestions are currently pending moderator review, and what are their unique suggestion identifiers and current status values?
evidence: "Pending review" indicates the status field value is 'pending'. Only include records where this specific status applies.
SQL: SELECT suggestion_id, status FROM content_suggestion_queue WHERE status = 'pending';

question: What are the configuration keys, values, and types for all items currently marked as active?
evidence: Active items have a status field equal to 'ACTIVE'.
SQL: SELECT config_key, config_value, config_type FROM gx_configuration_item WHERE status = 'ACTIVE';

question: Which moderators approved content suggestions? List the suggestion ID and the username of the reviewer who gave the approval for each item.
evidence: Approved suggestions are those with a status indicating final acceptance. The reviewer username links to the user who performed the moderation action.
SQL: SELECT c.suggestion_id, u.username FROM content_suggestion_queue c JOIN users u ON c.reviewer_id = u.id WHERE c.status = 'approved';

question: Which enabled users have recorded an 'ORDER_FILLED' event in the audit log?
evidence: 'Enabled' means account status is active. 'ORDER_FILLED' is the specific audit trail operation indicating a completed trade.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT u.username FROM user_audit_trail a JOIN users u ON a.username = u.username WHERE a.operation = 'ORDER_FILLED'   AND u.enabled = 1;

question: List all plugins currently marked as active in the system registry to verify their operational status.
evidence: Active plugins are those with a status of 'active' in the system registry, indicating they are operational.
SQL: SELECT * FROM system_plugins WHERE status = 'active';

question: What is the insurance policy number and provider for the Hala variety stock item sourced from Tunisia?
evidence: Stock item refers to inventory records. Hala is a specific variety. Tunisia is the country of origin.
SQL: SELECT pi.Policy_Number, pi.Insurer_Name FROM product_insurance pi JOIN stock s ON pi.Id_Stock = s.Id_Stock WHERE s.Jenis_Kurma = 'Hala'   AND s.Asal_Negara = 'Tunisia';

question: Which benefit types have total approved claims exceeding 100.0? List each benefit name alongside its corresponding total approved amount.
evidence: Approved claims are those with status 'approved'. The total is the sum of monetary values.
SQL: SELECT     bt.benefit_name,     SUM(ebc.amount) AS total_approved_amount FROM employee_benefit_claim ebc JOIN benefit_type bt ON ebc.benefit_id = bt.benefit_id WHERE ebc.status = 'approved' GROUP BY bt.benefit_id, bt.benefit_name HAVING SUM(ebc.amount) > 100.0 ORDER BY total_approved_amount DESC;

question: Show user IDs, role types, and assignment timestamps for all users holding the 'analyst' role in chat room 110.
evidence: Role type refers to the specific permission set assigned to a user within a chat room context.
SQL: SELECT user_id, role_type, assigned_at FROM user_role_in_room WHERE chat_room_id = 110 AND role_type = 'analyst'

question: Find the user ID and name of the Baltimore, MD-based individual with an Admin role, ensuring their education matches their administrative privileges.
evidence: Admin role requires matching education details. Baltimore, MD is the required location filter for the user profile.
SQL: SELECT      c.user_id,     u.name FROM collaboration c JOIN user_cv u ON c.user_id = u.user_id JOIN user_profile p ON c.user_id = p.user_id JOIN user_education e ON c.user_id = e.user_id WHERE c.role = 'Admin' AND p.location = 'Baltimore, MD'

question: List the user IDs for accounts with at least one identity verification attempt marked as revoked.
evidence: Identity verification attempts are linked to users. 'Revoked' is a specific status indicating the verification was invalidated.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT user_id  FROM user_identity_verification_attempts  WHERE status = 'revoked' ORDER BY user_id

question: Which courses have a 'Pull-up Test' grading component with a weight exceeding 0.5, and what are their descriptions?
evidence: Weight > 0.5 means the component contributes more than 50% of the total grade points.
SQL: SELECT c.course_name, c.course_description FROM course c JOIN grading_scheme gs ON c.course_id = gs.course_id WHERE gs.component = 'Pull-up Test' AND gs.weight > 0.5;

question: How many times did the 'schema_aligned' action occur in the audit logs for content item 32?
evidence: Audit logs record user actions. 'schema_aligned' is the specific action type. Content item 32 is the unique identifier for the resource.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM j_content_audits WHERE content_id = 32 AND action = 'schema_aligned'

question: What is the average rating for user 12, specifically for the 'calificacion_promedio' statistic type?
evidence: 'calificacion_promedio' is the specific metric name for average rating statistics.
SQL: SELECT valor FROM estadisticas_usuarios WHERE usuario = 12 AND tipo_estadistica = 'calificacion_promedio'

question: Which users have a completed identity verification and at least one successful TFA login?
evidence: Identity verification is completed when status is 'completed'. TFA login is successful when status is 'success'.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT iv.user_id FROM user_identity_verification_attempts iv INNER JOIN user_tfa_authentication_attempts tfa   ON iv.user_id = tfa.user_id WHERE iv.status = 'completed'   AND tfa.success = 1

question: Please provide the title of publication 44 and the name of the author designated as the Corresponding Author.
evidence: Publication ID is a unique numeric identifier. 'Corresponding Author' is a specific role attribute assigned to an author record.
SQL: SELECT p.title, a.name FROM bctw_research_publication p JOIN bctw_research_publication_author a ON p.publication_id = a.publication_id WHERE p.publication_id = 44 AND a.contribution = 'Corresponding Author'

question: Which employees approved purchase orders that have associated overage reports? For each, list their ID, the count of such approved orders, and the total overage quantity for those orders.
evidence: An approved purchase order must have at least one associated overage report to be included in the count and sum.
SQL: SELECT      a.APPROVED_BY,     COUNT(DISTINCT a.PURCHASE_ORDER_ID) AS num_approved_orders,     SUM(o.OVERAGE_QUANTITY) AS total_overage_qty FROM purchase_order_approvals a JOIN purchase_orders po ON a.PURCHASE_ORDER_ID = po.PURCHASE_ORDER_ID JOIN purchase_order_overage o ON po.PURCHASE_ORDER_ID = o.PURCHASE_ORDER_ID WHERE a.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'Approved' GROUP BY a.APPROVED_BY

question: Which task logs show a final execution status of 'SUCCESS', indicating that the associated operations have completed successfully?
evidence: 'SUCCESS' status confirms an operation finished its workflow without errors or interruptions.
SQL: SELECT * FROM TASK_LOGS WHERE STATUS = 'SUCCESS';

question: What is the name and upload date of the document uploaded by the user whose rejected digital signature request had ID 179?
evidence: Digital signature request ID 179 is rejected. 'Initiated by' means the user who created the request.
SQL: SELECT d.file_name, d.upload_date  FROM digital_signature_request dsr  JOIN document d ON dsr.document_id = d.id  WHERE dsr.id = 179 AND dsr.signature_status = 'rejected'

question: What is the average organizer fee for offline auctions with a paid payment status? This metric helps the finance department analyze revenue collection efficiency.
evidence: Offline auctions exclude online events. Organizer fee is the total cost charged to the event organizer. Paid status indicates completed transactions.
SQL: SELECT AVG(organizer_fee) AS average_organizer_fee FROM offline_auction_fee WHERE payment_status = 'paid';

question: What notification level has user 337326 configured for the DiluentBrand entity identified by ID 10057?
evidence: Notification levels are user-specific settings determining alert frequency for entity updates.
SQL: SELECT notificationLevel FROM user_subscription WHERE userId = 337326 AND entityType = 'DiluentBrand' AND entityId = 10057

question: List users who are Evaluator collaborators and have an average review rating of at least 4, including their name, institution, and degree.
evidence: Collaboration role 'Evaluator' indicates active partnership. Average rating is the mean of all associated review scores.
SQL: WITH reviewer_avg AS (     SELECT reviewer_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating     FROM review     GROUP BY reviewer_id     HAVING AVG(rating) >= 4 ), evaluator_users AS (     SELECT DISTINCT user_id     FROM collaboration     WHERE role = 'Evaluator' ) SELECT DISTINCT     uc.name,     ue.institution,     ue.degree FROM reviewer_avg ra JOIN evaluator_users eu ON ra.reviewer_id = eu.user_id JOIN user_cv uc ON ra.reviewer_id = uc.user_id JOIN user_education ue ON uc.user_id = ue.user_id

question: How many times have decks been shared with students, specifically counting all instances of the 'DECK_SHARED_WITH_STUDENT' notification type?
evidence: A notification instance represents a single alert sent to a user. 'DECK_SHARED_WITH_STUDENT' is the specific event type for deck sharing actions.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_notifications FROM SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_INSTANCES ni JOIN SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATES nt ON ni.TEMPLATE_ID = nt.ID WHERE nt.EVENT_TYPE = 'DECK_SHARED_WITH_STUDENT';

question: Which data sets are no longer in active use, and what are their system names and descriptions?
evidence: 'Deprecated' quality status indicates a data set is no longer in active use.
SQL: SELECT system, data_description FROM data_centralization WHERE quality_status = 'Deprecated';

question: What is the title and publication date of the GameSpot coverage for the 'Golden Western Night' event?
evidence: Coverage refers to media articles or reports. Golden Western Night is a specific event name.
SQL: SELECT mc.media_title, mc.date_published FROM event e JOIN media_coverage mc ON e.id = mc.event_id WHERE e.name = 'Golden Western Night' AND mc.outlet = 'GameSpot'

question: Which users reported moderate injuries and prefer in-app alerts for their emergency notifications?
evidence: Injury severity 'Moderate' and preference 'In-App Alert' are specific status values in the system.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT ui.user_information_name FROM user_information ui JOIN incident_casualty_records icr ON ui.id_user_information = icr.reported_by JOIN user_reporting_preference urp ON ui.id_user_information = urp.user_id WHERE icr.injury_severity = 'Moderate'   AND urp.preferred_method = 'In-App Alert';

question: What is the exact text of the notification template for the 'CHARACTER_MASTERED' event?
evidence: 'CHARACTER_MASTERED' is the event triggered when a student successfully learns a new character.
SQL: SELECT TEMPLATE_TEXT FROM SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION_TEMPLATES WHERE EVENT_TYPE = 'CHARACTER_MASTERED';

question: Which inventory transfers failed inspection? List their IDs, destination locations, and specific error messages for investigation.
evidence: Failed Inspection is a specific transfer status indicating rejection during quality control checks.
SQL: SELECT      t.transfer_id,     t.to_location,     e.error_message FROM inventory_transfers t JOIN inventory_transfer_error_logs e ON t.transfer_id = e.transfer_id WHERE t.status = 'Failed Inspection';

question: What is the total count of files stored in the 'Project Mobile App Storage' workspace for user profile 24?
evidence: Files are digital assets; workspace is a named collection; profile 24 is the user identifier.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_files WHERE profileId = 24 AND workspaceName = 'Project Mobile App Storage'

question: Which pairs have at least one participant schedule a date, and when were those matches created?
evidence: Schedule a date means the decision status is 'date_scheduled'. Match creation time is the initial timestamp of the pair record.
SQL: SELECT dp.id AS pair_id, dp.when_matched FROM dating_pair dp INNER JOIN pair_decision pd ON dp.id = pd.pair_id WHERE pd.decision = 'date_scheduled' GROUP BY dp.id, dp.when_matched;

question: How many total hours were spent on remediation for all incidents that reached a final status of 'Escalated to Senior Team'?
evidence: Remediation hours are the sum of time logged for fixing issues. 'Escalated to Senior Team' is the specific final status value for these incidents.
SQL: SELECT SUM(hours_spent) AS total_hours FROM incident_remediation_effort WHERE final_status = 'Escalated to Senior Team';

question: Which failed jobs have at least two temporary data keys? List their names and the counts of these keys.
evidence: Temporary data keys are entries in the system's transient storage. Job status 'FAILED' indicates an unsuccessful execution.
SQL: SELECT j.job_name, COUNT(t.data_key) AS temp_count FROM ptcore_batch_temp_data t JOIN ptcore_sys_job_history j ON t.job_id = j.job_id WHERE j.status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY j.job_name HAVING COUNT(t.data_key) >= 2;

question: Which parts were exported to the 'Seção de Digitalização', including the quantity shipped and the export date?
evidence: Parts refer to inventory items. 'Seção de Digitalização' is a specific destination branch for exported inventory.
SQL: SELECT      P.designacao,     E.quantidade,     E.dataExportacao FROM Exportacao E JOIN Peca P ON E.idPeca = P.idPeca WHERE E.destino = 'Seção de Digitalização';

question: Which integration names are currently in an ERROR state and have an active encryption algorithm configuration set to RSA-2048?
evidence: Active configuration means the key is currently enabled and not deprecated. Encryption algorithm refers to the specific cryptographic standard used for data protection.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT i.name FROM t_integration i JOIN t_integration_monitors m ON i.integration_id = m.integration_id JOIN t_integration_config c ON i.integration_id = c.integration_id WHERE m.status = 'ERROR'   AND c.key = 'encryption_algorithm'   AND c.value = 'RSA-2048';

question: Which users have completed requests for 'A4 Paper Ream' with item ID 1? List their names.
evidence: 'Completed' is the final approval status. Item ID 1 refers to 'A4 Paper Ream'.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT u.first_name, u.last_name FROM inventory_requests ir JOIN users u ON CAST(ir.requester_id AS TEXT) = u.id WHERE ir.item_id = 1   AND ir.approval_status = 'Completed';

question: What are the system names and data descriptions for records marked as 'Invalid' in the central data repository?
evidence: 'Invalid' refers to the quality_status field. The central data repository is the primary source of truth.
SQL: SELECT system, data_description FROM data_centralization WHERE quality_status = 'Invalid';

question: Show the ID, verification type, and status for all identity verification attempts that have reached a 'completed' status to audit successful verifications.
evidence: Identity verification attempts are records of user authentication processes. 'Completed' status indicates the process finished successfully.
SQL: SELECT id, verification_type, status FROM user_identity_verification_attempts WHERE status = 'completed';

question: Which user profile IDs have accepted a match in a currently active pairing?
evidence: Active pairing: status is 'active'. Accepted match: decision is 'accept'.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT pd.profile_id FROM pair_decision pd JOIN dating_pair dp ON pd.pair_id = dp.id WHERE pd.decision = 'accept'   AND dp.active = 1;

question: Retrieve the subjects of all messages sent to users who have selected 'Phone Call' as their preferred reporting method.
evidence: Preferred reporting method 'Phone Call' indicates users who wish to be contacted via voice communication rather than other channels.
SQL: SELECT mt.subject FROM message_thread mt JOIN user_reporting_preference up ON mt.recipient_id = up.user_id WHERE up.preferred_method = 'Phone Call'

question: What are the names and start times of all tasks that have successfully completed?
evidence: A task 'completed successfully' has a status of 'SUCCESS'. Start time is the timestamp when execution began.
SQL: SELECT TASK_NAME, START_TIME FROM TASK_LOGS WHERE STATUS = 'SUCCESS'

question: Which integration has a monitor currently in an ERROR state, and what is that monitor's check interval in seconds?
evidence: Monitor state ERROR indicates a failure. Check interval is the time between monitoring cycles, measured in seconds.
SQL: SELECT      i.name AS integration_name,     m.check_interval_SECONDS FROM t_integration_monitors m JOIN t_integration i ON m.integration_id = i.integration_id WHERE m.status = 'ERROR';

question: List channel names with at least one user having VIEW_DEFINITION permission, ordered by creation date ascending.
evidence: VIEW_DEFINITION is a specific user permission. Channel creation date determines the sort order.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT c.Nome FROM Canal c JOIN access_permission ap ON c.CanalId = ap.ChannelId WHERE ap.PermissionType = 'VIEW_DEFINITION' ORDER BY c.DataCriacao ASC;

question: Which marketing campaign names have received at least one negative feedback entry?
evidence: Negative feedback is indicated by a feedback sentiment score of -1.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT mc.campaign_name FROM marketing_campaigns mc JOIN campaign_feedback cf ON mc.campaign_id = cf.campaign_id WHERE cf.feedback_type = 'negative' ORDER BY mc.campaign_name;

question: List the names of staff members who have scheduled appointments with customers holding a 'Member' account type.
evidence: 'Staff members' are employees with active service roles. 'Member' is a specific customer account tier.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM staff s JOIN guest_service_appointments gsa ON s.id = gsa.staff_id JOIN customer c ON gsa.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.account_type = 'Member';

question: Which customers have expired KYC status and are currently active guarantors for loans?
